title: Add chapterStore cache invalidation to generateChapterSkeleton()
description: The generateChapterSkeleton() function creates chapters via SSE streaming but never invalidates the chapterStore cache. Add chapterStore.invalidateProjectChapters(projectId) after SSE completes (both success and abort paths), matching the existing createChapters() pattern.

files.change: Add chapterStore.invalidateProjectChapters(projectId) after await refresh() in generateChapterSkeleton() success path (L300) and abort path (L312). Add projectId to useCallback dependency array (L325).

criteria: projectId added to useCallback dependency array
Writing page shows parsed skeleton results without manual refresh
